name: Lockable disconnector
summary: A lockable disconnector has a mechanism that can retain the isolation position under a specified locking arrangement.
description: A lockable disconnector has a mechanism that can retain the isolation position under a specified locking arrangement. The representation needs the operating position and lock reference in addition to the main contact.
readingNotes: A drawn padlock marker does not define the full isolation procedure.
